adaptations: Original Rust metadata, hub, search, album, artist, playlist, radio and direct/transcode selection retained.
Native Keychain account supplied per cancellable operation; no global private account cache or persisted plaintext token in playlist metadata.
Explicit server-token connection and account-token resource discovery are available. Desktop shared-video-login secret discovery has no native counterpart yet.
Private artwork is represented by a connection-scoped token-free URI; original Plex inner and outer transcoder authorization is supplied only during bounded IO.
Artwork decoding and memory cache are bounded, per profile and retired on credential changes. Remote inner artwork sources are rejected.
Native UUID supplies a transcode session identifier; no new Rust randomness dependency or source-version change.
JSON API bodies capped at 8 MiB, cover bodies at 2 MiB, authenticated redirects confined to the original origin.
The original artist catalog limitation and first-music-library selection remain explicit.
